question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who physically travels in space.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Astronaut"** means a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft. (अंतरिक्ष यात्री)

 
 
• **Example:** Neil Armstrong was the first astronaut to walk on the moon.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Astronaut**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Anarchist** (अराजकतावादी): A person who believes in or tries to bring about anarchy.

 
 
• **Example:** The anarchist was known for his radical views against the government.
 
 
 
• **Pilot** (पायलट): A person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft.
 
 
• **Example:** The pilot skillfully landed the plane despite the bad weather.
 
 
 
• **Astrologer** (ज्योतिषी): A person who uses astrology to tell others about their character or to predict their future.
 
 
• **Example:** The astrologer predicted that she would have a bright future.
